title: apiScreenshot
responsibility: Selects an attested recorded page capture, verifies its hash and saves its original bytes and provenance.

inputs.name: apiScreenshot.client
inputs.description: Required API client for the selected local console or hosted project. Snapshot, evidence and artifact requests retain server authorization and revision identity.

inputs.name: apiScreenshot.entityId
inputs.description: Required registered visual entity id whose recorded screenshot is requested.

inputs.name: apiScreenshot.options
inputs.description: Required options object. output requires a new file path. Optional size (--size WIDTHxHEIGHT) defaults to JavaScript undefined: no CSS viewport-size filter. Width/height are 1-16384, lowercase x, no spaces/signs/leading zeros. size conflicts with viewport (--viewport id), whose omitted default is also undefined and whose existing id matching is unchanged. state/scenario default undefined (no filter), side defaults after; commit selects historical mode.

outputs.name: apiScreenshot
outputs.type: Promise<{ path: string; entityId: string; commit: string; scenario: string; state: string; viewport: string | null; sha256: string; mediaType: string; capturedAt: string; inheritedFrom: string | null; focused: object | null; verification: object }>
outputs.description: Saved screenshot metadata: absolute path, entityId, commit, scenario, state, original viewport id, SHA-256, media type, capture timestamp, inherited/focused provenance and honest verification status. Original image bytes are written exclusively to the new file; CSS size never resizes pixels.

errors.name: Invalid screenshot selection
errors.description: Rejects malformed/out-of-bounds --size, simultaneous --size/--viewport, missing output, invalid side, missing or ambiguous captures, missing record binding, non-image media, or an integrity mismatch. A missing exact size requires a standard committed recording with original viewport metadata.

errors.name: Transport or file write error
errors.description: API authorization/network/deadline errors propagate. File write errors propagate, including EEXIST so an existing output is never overwritten.
